# hetznerrobot_server_market_order (Resource)

Orders a dedicated server from the server market (`hetznerrobot_server_market_products`). Market offers come and go; a product id that is gone fails the order. Without the `primary_ipv4` addon the server is delivered IPv6-only.

~> **Destroying this resource does not cancel anything.** It only removes the order from state; what was ordered keeps running and is billed until it is cancelled.

Ordering through the webservice has to be enabled in Robot first (Administration → Settings → Web service settings → Ordering). Robot accepts 20 orders per day; prices are in the account's currency (`hetznerrobot_currency`). Create waits for the transaction to become `ready` (see `timeouts`). When the wait ends early the order stays placed: the apply finishes with a warning, and a later refresh fills in what is still missing — it never orders twice. Robot keeps transactions for 30 days; after that the state simply stays as it is.

Cancel the server with `hetznerrobot_server_cancellation`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The cheapest market offer with at least 64 GB of memory.
data "hetznerrobot_server_market_products" "all" {}

locals {
  candidates = [for p in data.hetznerrobot_server_market_products.all.products : p if p.memory_size >= 64]
  lowest     = min([for c in local.candidates : tonumber(c.price)]...)
  cheapest   = [for p in local.candidates : p if tonumber(p.price) == local.lowest][0]
}

# Places a real, billed order. Destroying this resource does NOT cancel the
# server — use hetznerrobot_server_cancellation for that.
resource "hetznerrobot_server_market_order" "storage" {
  product_id      = local.cheapest.id
  authorized_keys = [hetznerrobot_ssh_key.admin.fingerprint]
  addons          = ["primary_ipv4"]

  # Validate the order without placing it:
  # test = true

  lifecycle {
    # Market offers come and go; never re-order because the cheapest changed.
    ignore_changes = [product_id]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (Number) Market product id (`hetznerrobot_server_market_products`). Changing it orders a new server.

### Optional

- `addons` (Set of String) Addon ids, e.g. `primary_ipv4` — without it the server has no IPv4 address.
- `authorized_keys` (Set of String) Fingerprints of SSH keys stored in Robot (`hetznerrobot_ssh_key`) to install for root. Set this or `password`.
- `comment` (String) Order comment. **A comment makes Robot process the order manually**, which takes longer.
- `dist` (String) Distribution to preinstall, e.g. `Rescue system` or a name from the product's `dists`. Changing a set value orders a new server.
- `lang` (String) Language of the preinstalled distribution, e.g. `en`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Root password. Set this or `authorized_keys`; never read back.
- `test` (Boolean) When true, Robot validates the order but does not process it — nothing is ordered or billed, and no server number is ever assigned.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `date` (String) Date the order was placed.
- `host_keys` (List of String) Fingerprints of the new server's SSH host keys, once ready.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IPv4 address of the new server, once ready (null for an IPv6-only server).
- `server_number` (Number) Number of the new server, once the transaction is `ready`.
- `status` (String) Transaction status: `in process`, `ready` or `cancelled`.
- `transaction_id` (String) Id of the order transaction, e.g. `B20150121-344958-251479`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Works only while Robot still keeps the transaction (30 days).
tofu import hetznerrobot_server_market_order.storage B20261012-1234568-251480
```
